intro: One handful of kuaci (the part you eat) has about 160 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the fat in the seed kernels.

variants.name: Caramel or green tea flavoured kuaci

diet: Yes, kuaci is fine as a lepak snack. The good thing is you have to crack them one by one, so you eat slower. But during raya or while watching football, you can finish a whole pack without noticing. Stick to one handful and put it on a small plate.
tips: Pour one handful onto a plate, then put the pack back in the cupboard.
Choose original flavour, not caramel or sugar-coated.
Keep plain water next to you because salted kuaci makes you thirsty fast.

swap.name: Boiled peanuts in shell, 1 handful
swap.why: You still need to shell them so you eat slowly, but fewer calories and less salt.

faq.q: Can eating a lot of kuaci give you a sore throat?
faq.a: Many people feel their throat gets dry because of the salt and flavouring on the shells. Drink enough water and choose less salty kuaci.

faq.q: Black or white kuaci, which is better?
faq.a: The calories are about the same. Pick whichever you like, what matters is the portion.
A little, about 5g per handful. But it's mostly fat, so don't make it your main protein source.
